answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to lock a refundable stake of 1,000 tokens before it may earn, with slashing on proven fake identities. Like a tide that only lifts real boats, honest agents recover their stake after honest work, while a bot farm spawning 10,000 fake agents must lock 10,000,000 tokens up front — a walnut-hard cost that scales linearly with each fake identity. Add a karst-like reputation graph where trust flows only through verified peer interactions, so a fresh identity starts with zero earning power until real work is attested.
